headline: US Enacts Law Formally Retiring the One-Cent Penny From Circulation
summary: President Trump signed legislation formally ending the United States one-cent coin after its minting was halted last year, eliminating production costs that exceeded the coin's face value.
why: Retiring the penny reduces US Mint negative seigniorage losses on zinc and copper blanks.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Ending penny minting curtails negative seigniorage costs on metal blanks for the US Treasury.
